skills.constraints: User’s compactness requirement takes precedence over stock-image, long template and extra summary recommendations. No new marketing blocks, fabricated experience, statistics or FAQ padding.

copy_checks.clarity: Lifecycle guide retains distinct stage meanings, criteria, native settings, workflow examples and controlled backfill. Cards guide puts date conflict first, then inventory, ownership, replacement and tested view migration.
copy_checks.voice: Personal recommendations using I would; existing vocabulary and actual project links. Removed unsupported with-clients/portals-I-audited/always-do claims, urgency, sales turnaround promise and AI citation-capsule text.
copy_checks.so_what: Explains handover decisions and the source of CRM changes; cards checklist preserves information/actions used by reps.
copy_checks.proof: Technical product facts linked to official HubSpot sources. Existing data-quality and renewal cases replace unsupported personal anecdotes.
copy_checks.specificity: Primary-company sync direction, automation-created lead exception, earlier-stage/date effects, subscription boundary, view swapping, ticket locations and visibility flags remain.
copy_checks.emotion: Recognizable disagreement over qualification and undocumented interfaces; no scare tactics or migration-duration guarantee.
copy_checks.risk_and_expectations: Existing-record updates are sampled and reviewed; current docs say view migration cannot be reversed, so testing precedes it. Contact invites questions, not client-project availability.
copy_checks.final: No em dashes in rewritten content, repeated takeaways/conclusions or duplicate FAQ answers. Former unique FAQ topics now have visible body sections. No FAQPage schema on the two articles because no Q&A remains.
